_comment: Boss loot (design/gdd/boss-loot.md, Boss 2026-11-16), read by logic/boss_loot.gd. One entry per zone boss (key = data/world/zones.json zone id). On a WON run of the zone's journey (server, Journey.pay_card_xp) each account gets: coins_per_kill of `coin` (a camp.json material, never scaled); a `piece_chance` chance of one random piece of `set` (uniform over the set's catalog items), its tier rolled from data/loot/loot.json tier_weights at the boss's level (the journey's last stage, enemy with boss: true); a `relic_chance` chance of one `relic` (a camp.json material). Both chances x that player's loot_by_squad factor. first_kill_min_tier: the account's first win (before unlocks.boss_<zone> is set) guarantees one piece of at least this tier (rerolled tier below it is raised to it); it replaces that run's piece roll. price_coins: the shop price of each set piece in this boss's coin. shop_tier_weights (Boss 2026-11-16): relative weights over rules.json tiers [normal, rare, epic, legendary] for the tier a BOUGHT piece rolls (normal is 0: a bought piece is never white) (server rng, one draw). weapon_drops (Boss 2026-11-21): fixed boss-unique weapons (catalog no_drop, no set, never in the shop, never converted by race_drops.json): each entry is an independent `chance` x factor roll on a WON run, the piece's tier rolled like a set piece (first kill does not guarantee it). 5% each = the chance of any ONE specific accessory (25% over 5 pieces). The roll is in logic/boss_loot.gd (_grant_weapons) but OFF until the Boss approves: it runs only for an entry with "weapon_drops_enabled": true (absent = off). PLACEHOLDER numbers (25% / 1% / 500 are the GDD's; the 500-coin farm time is flagged for a Boss check in GDD 3).

orc_camp._placeholder: 2026-11-21 PLACEHOLDER until the Orc Warlock's own set/coin/relic/icons exist (checklist section 4): the Warlock pays the Mummy High Wizard's set, coin and relic with the same chances. price_coins 0 = no second shop listing of the same pieces (the pyramid entry already sells them). No weapon_drops yet. Boss option (gold + status proc, data/items/boss_options.json): the mummy pieces carry their mummy options here too; to swap, point set/coin/relic at the Warlock's own ids, add its catalog items with boss "orc_camp" and one boss_options.json entry per piece (tests/test_boss_procs.gd lists any piece without one).
